title: Run live macOS Swift XCTests over Rust MangaCoreFFI + all 3 Wave 1 Apple builds (v0.2.2)
summary: Added standalone MangaStudio-macOS-Tests XCTest target (MangaStudioV022Tests.swift) exercising live Rust FFI on Apple Silicon: Tri-App RAM budgets & write-ownership isolation, S1 .prj disk bootstrap, S2 brush dynamics & sparse CoW undo/redo, S3 mixed CJK+Latin counting, and 18 MIT icons / 3 paper themes.
